groups.title: Surfaces
groups.note: Page and panel backgrounds, darkest to lightest (surface-0 … surface-3).

groups.title: Text
groups.note: Text colors. Use primary / secondary / muted for hierarchy.

groups.title: Text tints
groups.note: Colored text for labels and tags.

groups.title: Fills
groups.note: Interactive fills: buttons, controls, fields, ghost hovers.

groups.title: Backgrounds (status and tint)
groups.note: Soft status backgrounds for banners, chips and callouts.

groups.title: Alpha overlays
groups.note: Translucent white (dark mode) or black (light mode). They adapt to any surface.

groups.title: On-colors
groups.note: Text or icon color to put on top of the matching fill.

groups.title: Role scales
groups.note: Full scales behind accent / danger / success / warning / pro.
